scope: Operator-requested natural forward approach; replaces earlier chest-facing travel policy
qualification: Component contracts TESTED; forward-policy graphical retest NOT RUN
authorized_policy_change: Face travel and primarily use W instead of A/S/D-heavy chest-facing movement.
Allow A/D only for a tiny aligned correction, never backwards travel.
Use bounded stopped target checkpoints rather than forcing a look-back after each pulse.
construction: Forward-facing route alignment uses shortest-arc eight-degree camera commands; no drive during larger turn stages.
A/D requires a waypoint nearer than 0.35 blocks and camera adjustment at most eight degrees, with a one-tick input.
Navigation/visibility are sampled after movement; actor/readiness/hazard/deadline/cancel and cleanup remain unchanged.
Out-of-view target memory permits at most eight unconfirmed movement pulses; a cooperative three-second threshold also requests a stopped check.
Fresh visible-interactable/on-demand sight confirmation is required to resume. Cached renderer crosshair hits cannot reset the budget.
Observed replacement/absence in central view stops immediately; no silent retarget, use/open or inventory operation.
Success still requires the exact native block ID/position plus fresh sight corroboration and a supported standing position.
test_notes: AR16/AR17 direction/allowed-key and bounded-camera contracts were updated for the explicitly requested policy, not target-facing movement.
Travel-heading alignment, forward dominance, bounded checkpoint glances and single-tick corrections replace the former target-facing global yaw-total oracle.
AR20-AR25 cover temporary out-of-view travel, pulse/time bounds, target loss without retarget, checkpoint actor/cancel guards and stale renderer-hit rejection.
Earlier arrival PASS, camera feedback and source hashes remain historical in separate manifests.
limits: Three-second checks are cooperative between actions, not a hard wall-clock guarantee during network/game stalls.
Pulse bounds are not physical-distance or no-damage guarantees under arbitrary native attributes/mods.
Flat loaded full-block/cardinal routing and short leases remain; human-like continuous movement, pixel smoothness, modpack and isolated graphical acceptance are unqualified.
No Java/RPC/trust/physics changes or publication approval.
